resources.string: Tap the button below, then hold the customer\'s phone against the back of yours. You will see the amount and can accept or cancel.
The money was added to your balance.
That card code is not valid or has expired. Ask the customer to try again.
This payment was already taken, cancelled or has expired.
Only business accounts can collect payments.
The customer does not have enough balance.
Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
Too many tries. Wait a moment and try again.
Something went wrong. Please try again.
Ready: hold the customer\'s phone against yours
More than one phone nearby. Ask one customer to touch phones
This phone has no Bluetooth Low Energy, so it cannot collect payments this way.
Bluetooth is off. Turn it on to collect payments.
Turn on location so Android lets this phone scan for customers (this phone\'s Android version needs it).
Allow nearby devices access so this phone can find customers.
This phone cannot broadcast over Bluetooth, so customers cannot find it. Use a different phone to collect.
Could not start Bluetooth broadcasting. Turn Bluetooth off and on, then try again.
Could not start Bluetooth scanning. Turn Bluetooth off and on, then try again.
This payment is over the Bluetooth limit.
The signal was weak. Make sure the customer is standing right next to you before you accept.
The customer\'s phone could not confirm it is nearby. Only accept if they are standing right next to you.
